To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the quantitative aspects of real time and embedded systems are important and that there are several approaches to modeling and analysis of such systems.

(1) the quantitative analysis of real-time and/or embedded systems requires a model-driven approach, (2) the quantitative analysis can be done in the early stages of model-driven development and (3) quantitative models can be used for validation and verification.

the use of quantitative information in the modeling and design of real-time and distributed systems is essential to achieve a better understanding of the system behavior and to support the development of high quality systems.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the quantitative modeling and analysis of complex embedded systems.

the development of methods and tools for the quantitative evaluation of the performance and reliability of real-time and/or embedded systems, and for the integration of such quantitative analysis into model driven development of such systems.

modeling and analysis of real-time and distributed systems, in particular with the development of methods, tools, and techniques for the quantitative evaluation of real-time and performance requirements of such systems.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

quantitative aspects of real time and embedded systems have been recognized as a major concern and that there is an increasing need to develop and apply quantitative analysis techniques and tools for these systems.
there is still a lot of work to be done in the area of modeling and analysis of real-time and especially embedded systems.
the workshop was a success, and that we are looking forward to a second edition.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we are at the beginning of an exciting era where the quantitative analysis of real-time and/or embedded systems is becoming an integral part of model driven development.
there is an increasing interest in quantitative analysis of real-time and distributed embedded systems.
we have made a good start, but we still have a long way to go.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the quantitative aspects of real time and embedded systems should be considered early in the design phase.
quantitative analysis of real-time and complex systems can benefit from model-driven development and that model-driven development can benefit from the availability of quantitative analysis methods.
there is a need for a quantitative modeling language for real-time and embedded system that is based on the UML and can be used in model driven development.
